description: A hub-and-spoke concept diagram of what an ERP is. In the CENTER a large rounded cylinder (a database) labelled 'One shared record' with a smaller grey line under it 'Northbridge Cycles'. Around it, evenly spaced on a circle, six rounded rectangles (modules), each joined to the center cylinder by a thin two-way arrow. Their labels, clockwise from top: 'Purchasing', 'Stores', 'Finance', 'Production', 'Sales', 'People and payroll'. Inside each module box, under its name, one short grey italic caption: Purchasing 'requests, orders'; Stores 'stock, goods received'; Finance 'invoices, payments'; Production 'what to build, when'; Sales 'bike shops, dispatch'; People and payroll 'leave, salaries'. The center cylinder is filled light sky blue; module boxes are white with thin grey outlines. Wide 16:9 landscape composition. Labels as plain text, no brackets, spelled exactly as given, no other text.

A left-to-right architecture diagram with six columns joined by arrows, showing how one sentence becomes a saved order. Column 1: a rounded speech box with the text 'Order the battery packs from Voltway Cells' and above it a small grey label 'Emma types one sentence'. Column 2: a large rounded panel filled light sky blue labelled 'Harness' with three small white chips stacked inside it: 'instructions', 'conversation so far', 'list of 15 tools'. Column 3: a rounded box with a thin sky-blue outline labelled 'LLM' and a smaller line 'picks the next tool, or replies'. Column 4: a tall narrow vertical bar labelled 'MCP'. Column 5: a rounded panel labelled 'Toolbox' containing four stacked white boxes with monospace labels 'check_stock', 'create_purchase_request', 'create_purchase_order', 'receive_goods', and a small grey caption under the panel 'one tool per business activity'. Column 6: a rounded box filled light ember orange labelled 'Ledgerline ERP 7.2' with a smaller line 'services: input in, output out'. A thin arrow loops from the LLM back to the Harness labelled 'result, then decide again'. A return arrow along the bottom runs from column 6 back to column 1 labelled 'receipt: order RELEASED, gross 285,600 GBP'. Wide 16:9 landscape composition. Labels as plain text, no brackets, spelled exactly as given, no other text.

A concept diagram of one tool. On the LEFT a folder shape labelled 'create_purchase_order/' containing two file cards stacked vertically. The upper file card is labelled 'tool.json' with four short monospace lines inside it: 'name', 'description', 'input_schema', 'output_schema'. The lower file card is labelled 'tool.py' with one monospace line inside 'def run(s, supplier_code, request_no, confirm)'. In the MIDDLE an arrow from tool.json pointing up-right to a box filled light sky blue labelled 'LLM', the arrow labelled 'what the model reads'. A second arrow from tool.py pointing right to a box filled light ember orange labelled 'Ledgerline services' with three small monospace chips inside 'po_fetch', 'po_save', 'po_get', the arrow labelled 'what runs'. On the far RIGHT a small rounded white card labelled 'receipt' with two monospace lines 'status APPROVED' and 'gross 285,600 GBP'. An arrow from Ledgerline services to the receipt card. Wide 16:9 landscape composition. Labels as plain text, no brackets, spelled exactly as given, no other text.

A wide 16:9 diagram of how a twelve-lecture course is organised, read left to right, standing on one shared foundation. At the BOTTOM, spanning the full width, a long rounded band filled light ember orange with the label 'One running company: Northbridge Cycles on Ledgerline ERP 7.2 (1998)'. Above the band, three rounded panels side by side, joined by two thick right-pointing arrows. PANEL 1, the widest, white with a sky-blue outline, header 'Lectures 1 to 7 · Build each piece by hand'. Inside panel 1, a horizontal row of seven small rounded boxes labelled 'Before and After', 'Brain', 'Memory', 'Hands', 'Loop', 'Studio', 'Trust', each with a small number above it from 1 to 7. Under that row, a small closed loop of four short labels joined by curved arrows in a circle: 'build', 'break it', 'measure', 'fix'. PANEL 2, filled light sky blue, header 'Lectures 8 to 11 · The production stack'. Inside panel 2, four stacked rounded boxes with small numbers 8 to 11: 'Frameworks', 'Protocols', 'Observability and evals', 'Running in production', and a short caption 'the same agent on industry tools, measured'. PANEL 3, filled light green, header 'Lecture 12 · Your own module'. Inside panel 3, one rounded box 'your domain, your use case' and a short caption 'demo day'. Above all three panels, one thin line of text centered: 'One agent, Ask Northbridge, grows one piece per lecture'. Labels as plain text, no brackets, spelled exactly as given, no other text.

A wide 16:9 architecture diagram showing one agent run on three different runtimes, all traced into one place. On the LEFT, a tall rounded box filled light ember orange labelled 'Ledgerline ERP 7.2', and just to its right a tall rounded white box with a sky-blue outline labelled 'Toolbox over MCP' with the small caption '15 tools, the same for all three'. In the MIDDLE, three parallel rounded horizontal boxes stacked vertically, each connected by a thin arrow to the Toolbox box on the left: top box 'Our harness' with small caption 'built by hand, Lectures 5 and 7'; middle box 'OpenAI Agents SDK' with caption 'Agent, tools, Runner'; bottom box 'LangGraph' with caption 'a graph of steps with saved state'. Above the three middle boxes, a wide rounded box filled light sky blue labelled 'Model API' with small caption 'several LLMs, swapped one at a time', connected down to all three middle boxes with thin arrows. On the RIGHT, a tall rounded box filled light green labelled 'Langfuse' with three short lines inside 'every model call', 'every tool call', 'tokens, cost, time'; thin dashed arrows from each of the three middle boxes go right into Langfuse, labelled 'traces'. Along the bottom, spanning the width, a thin rounded strip with the text 'Same missions, same checks on Ledgerline: passed, never-events, tokens, cost, time'. Labels as plain text, no brackets, spelled exactly as given, no other text.
